About Me

The Creative Mind Behind the Work

Hi, I'm Gopa Dutta — a passionate Graphic Designer, Motion Graphic Artist, and Video Editor based in India. I believe great design is more than aesthetics — it's about telling stories, evoking emotions, and creating memorable experiences.

From luxury jewelry brand identities and e-commerce UI to 2D animation portfolios and social media campaigns, I work with brands and creators to bring their vision to life with precision and creativity.
